correctness.rationale: In the fixed 1<p<2 regime Euclidean diameter two occurs only at d isolated axis pairs ±e_i. Endpoint graphs x±=(±(1-||u||_p^p)^(1/p),u) give deficit [Σ(|u_j|^p+|v_j|^p)]/p(1+o(1)) uniformly. The line-through-endpoints slope/intercept Jacobian at the axis is exactly 2^(-(d-1)); independent block determinant checks were made for transverse dimensions 1..5. Rescaling by (p eps)^(1/p) gives a 2(d-1)-dimensional p-ball, its gamma-function volume and uniform measure. Total hitting-line measure κ_{d-1} S_p/2 follows from Cauchy projection identity. d equivalent axis pairs give the coefficient; transformed coordinate absolute p-powers plus slack yield Dirichlet(1/p,...,1/p,1). The Euclidean-ball p=2 endpoint has continuous maximum diameters and is correctly EXCLUDED.
